name: ex-v3
idea_origin: Exploración line, 29 Oct: replica calibrated on the 2,743 real DeepSeek story decisions (choice model, scripts/exploracion/); quality judge on cp-v12
operator: ex-v1 + discreet handling preferred over public confrontation in the review month at the starting level
hypothesis: In the L1 review month DeepSeek (and Sonnet in the bank) rejects private or written-afterwards options as hidden risk and picks public corrections, refusals or stands that cost Network or Output. In the catalog, options worded as private/quiet/later/in writing carry risk 2 or more only 11 % of the time and lose Network or Output 25 %; public stands, refusals and firm pushes lose them 46-64 % and are not less risky. Calibrated replica: +0.35 (penalty on public stands in the L1 review month).
predicted_behaviour: L1 bank: Network/Output-lowering choices 18 or fewer, risky choices 9 or fewer.
refutation: L1 bank: more than 21 Network/Output-lowering choices or more than 9 risky choices.
change: ex-v1 + one paragraph at the end of story step 4.
